_note: The real floor, in the Lighthouse frame of calibration.yaml (metres, yaw degrees CCW). Use it with ARENA=manager/arena.floor.json. FIELD: 5 m (x) by 3 m (y), assumed centred on the Lighthouse origin (which is inside the net): x -2.5..2.5, y -1.5..1.5. CHECK on the floor: put a Crazyflie in two opposite corners and read its pose; if the field is shifted or the long side runs along y, change bounds, drone_cage, zones and home here AND drone_server.py DEFAULT_CAGE (tests/test_integration.py keeps the two cages equal). drone_cage = bounds 0.3 m in from each wall. Zones, home, launch pad and overhead tags are provisional; measure them with the target Crazyflie as a wand and set calibrated:true. manager/arena.json stays the mock/test arena.
_view_note: view = what the dashboard map shows: the 5 x 3 m field plus a 0.4 m margin (the map also grows by itself if a robot or the pad is outside). launch_pad = where the scout sits before takeoff; the drone server reports the real one (its first takeoff spot) once it has flown. Measure it and fill it in.

overhead._note: PLACEHOLDER. Railing camera above one edge of the net, looking down at an angle. ArUco tags 0-3 (DICT_4X4_50) flat on the floor just outside the net corners; enter their measured centres. camera_floor_xy = the floor point straight below the lens (it may be outside the net), camera_height_m = lens height above the floor.

_cage_note: drone_cage measured 2026-10-11: largest x/y-aligned box inside the drone's Lighthouse reception corners (2.208,-0.683) (1.96,1.18 from 2026-10-10) (-2.551,1.195) (-1.633,-0.755); no inset. Same as drone_server.py DEFAULT_CAGE.
